answer: One defense anchors each identity to a physical latency fingerprint. Agents answer periodic probes from anchor nodes, and the network records round-trip times reflecting real distance. A genuine operator sits in one place, so its delays form a stable signature; even a faint whisper of jitter gets flagged statistically. An attacker spawning clones cannot make every duplicate answer from the same vantage point on a knoll without detour hops, which inflate latency beyond tolerance. Each fake identity needs its physical link and path, multiplying cost until the sybil strategy collapses.
